notes:
1. Section 4 ("Musk says debt access has shut off") says "and that is worth keeping in mind when reading his view". Source (CNBC): "Musk's SpaceX operates its own data centers through which it sells computing capacity. SpaceX is a direct competitor to the neoclouds which also rent compute." CNBC states the competitor fact but does not say it should colour how his view is read; that is the desk's own editorial steer and implies a motive the source does not give. Fix: drop the clause and state the source's fact, e.g. "Musk's SpaceX operates its own data centers through which it sells computing capacity, and CNBC describes it as a direct competitor to the neoclouds."
2. Section 2 title says "Itaú agrees to buy its supplier". Source (Itaú filing): "NeoSpace has been providing services to Itaú for nearly two years by developing models trained on Itaú's proprietary data." The filing never calls NeoSpace a supplier. Fix: "Itaú agrees to buy the AI startup it has worked with" (or "Itaú agrees to buy NeoSpace").
